tasks.description: 1.1 Complete the early custody and baseline milestones in [evaluation tasks](../ladon-proof-contract-evaluation/tasks.md), before runtime edits; verify immutable baseline/corpus-policy manifests and a local-checkout launcher. Evidence: evaluation [BASELINE.json](../ladon-proof-contract-evaluation/evidence/BASELINE.json) and [PROTOCOL.json](../ladon-proof-contract-evaluation/evidence/PROTOCOL.json). Independent custody preparation recorded C blocked with zero admitted cases before contract runtime edits; discovery gates remain open.

1.2 Accept the [domain capability](../ladon-proof-contract-domain/specs/proofir-mathematical-contracts/spec.md) from its child acceptance evidence, including the Lean soundness feasibility result and native-reader compatibility; leave this gate open if either is incomplete. [Accepted bounded domain](../ladon-proof-contract-domain/evidence/ACCEPTANCE.md); no source-fidelity or analytic-extraction claim is inherited.

2.1 Accept [producer](../ladon-proof-contract-producers/specs/ladon-contract-production/spec.md) and [propagation](../ladon-proof-contract-propagation/specs/ladon-contract-propagation/spec.md) child evidence; verify one independently sourced statement pair reaches a realizable frontier through their public operations.

2.2 Accept [bidirectional](../ladon-proof-contract-bidirectional/specs/ladon-contract-obligations/spec.md) and [probe](../../specs/ladon-contract-probes/spec.md) evidence; verify an exact localized obligation is checked without importing its disputed premise. [Accepted localized source-contract gate](evidence/localized-obligation-20261020/REPORT.md): 13 accepted goals, 18 verified raw receipts, resumed controls under the original clock, and independent acceptance #896; earlier rejection #893 retained.

2.3 Accept [refinement](../ladon-proof-contract-refinement/specs/ladon-contract-refinement/spec.md) evidence; verify original findings survive both a justified abstraction refinement and a separate proposed repair. [Accepted CLI/report evidence](../ladon-proof-contract-refinement/evidence/public-refinement-cli.md), independent review #1321; source fidelity and historical proof-provenance limits remain explicit.

2.4 Wire the opt-in contract audit driver and stage dispatch with immutable outputs, shared deadline and resource limits; verify the public entrypoint's help, a successful fixture, partial-stage resume and a memory-stop path, and document the runnable workflow.

2.5 Attach contract results to investigation observation/review/report and version any changed receipt projection; verify an observation-only discrepancy survives aggregation and finalization while historical receipt fixtures still validate, and document result dimensions.

3.1 Run integration checks across native payload/reference validation, producer identities, propagation, correspondence, investigation findings and installed CLI behavior; record exact commands and results against frozen runtime inputs.

3.2 Run the repository's applicable full verification and quality checks once on the integrated implementation, with an independent code/mathematical boundary review; preserve evidence and resolve consequential findings before declaring implementation readiness. The [latest full-run evidence](evidence/deleted-source-identity-20261023/REPORT.md) records 4,885 passed, one skipped and two live source-drift failures; both failed cases passed separately and under a source snapshot. The full snapshot run was interrupted, and no final-tree full pass is established. Reuse the [0.4.0 checks](evidence/development-snapshot-0.4.0/verification-reuse.json) for their actual scope; the user declined a redundant rerun on 2026-10-24. Keep this gate open.

3.3 Accept [evaluation protocol and measured reports](../ladon-proof-contract-evaluation/specs/ladon-contract-evaluation/spec.md) from the child without relabeling blocked or negative tracks; verify every case remains accounted for.

3.4 Establish the parent detection-benefit gate only if the evaluation's predeclared promotion rule passes; verify counts and source/custody evidence in an independent adjudication. Keep this task open when benefit is unestablished, even if implementation tasks are complete.

3.5 Publish the current outcome, evidence links, limitations and next action in the umbrella acceptance record; verify it distinguishes implementation readiness from detection benefit and preserves previous handoffs. Current capability and open evaluation gates are recorded above, with earlier handoffs retained.

instruction:
Recover the requested outcome and next useful result from the context files.
Work through tasks, run their completion checks, and record progress once.
Test consequential uncertain assumptions before expensive dependent work.
A failed probe stops expansion of that implementation; try a bounded alternative
within existing authorization, unchanged acceptance conditions, and the remaining
budget. Count all attempts against that budget. Keep capability tasks open until
their acceptance gates pass. Diagnose ordinary failures within scope; pause
when no viable authorized next step is available, naming the limiting dependency,
decision, or budget rather than treating one failed route as impossibility.
Report demonstrated outcomes and verification separately from checked tasks.
